title: Decide how a bead's criteria are tracked and how its open questions block the start (ADR-0066)
acceptance_criteria:
AC-1: ADR-0066 records numbered criteria, the meets: trailer, open-question markers, and what was rejected from spec-kit
AC-2: the plan names the implementation steps with numbered criteria of their own
AC-3: the user ratifies or amends ADR-0066 before CRIT-2 or CRIT-3 starts

title: Numbered criteria: AC-n lines in a bead, a meets: trailer, and the Objective section lists each criterion as met here, met earlier or open
acceptance_criteria:
AC-1: a bead whose acceptance_criteria has AC-n lines renders each criterion in the Objective section; a bead without them renders as before, byte for byte
AC-2: a commit's meets: AC-n marks that criterion of its objective as met in this PR; one met by an earlier commit on the target naming the same objective shows as met earlier
AC-3: objective-focus warns on an unknown criterion id, on meets: with no objective, and on a PR that closes the bead with a numbered criterion still open, naming each
AC-4: the commit-msg hook accepts meets: without a capture block, and the skill tells agents to number criteria and write meets:

title: Open questions: [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: …] in a bead blocks the claim and shows in the digest, the reminder and the PR view
acceptance_criteria:
AC-1: nugit objective claim refuses a bead carrying a marker and prints each question; -force claims and the claim records the count
AC-2: the SessionStart digest and the pre-edit reminder list the open questions of a branch's objective however it was resolved
AC-3: the Objective section lists open questions, and objective-focus warns when a PR closes a bead that still carries one
AC-4: nugit's skill tells agents to answer a question by editing the bead in the PR that acts on it
